cd "C:/visual projects/alpha"; K="-i $HOME/.ssh/id_rsa -o UserKnownHostsFile=$HOME/.ssh/known_hosts"; tr -d '\r' < tools/compute/gate/gate-families.sh > /tmp/gf.sh; ssh $K root@89.163.242.211 'mkdir -p /data/tk172' && scp $K /tmp/gf.sh root@89.163.242.211:/data/tk172/gate-families.sh && ssh $K root@89.163.242.211 'cat > /data/tk172/run.sh <<"EOF"

s=$(date +%s); bash /data/tk172/gate-families.sh --selftest r2; echo COLD $(( $(date +%s)-s )) > /data/tk172/walls.txt; cp /data/tk164/gate-172/r2.txt /data/tk172/r2-cold.txt
s=$(date +%s); bash /data/tk172/gate-families.sh --selftest r2; echo WARM $(( $(date +%s)-s )) >> /data/tk172/walls.txt; cp /data/tk164/gate-172/r2.txt /data/tk172/r2-warm.txt
touch /data/tk172/done
EOF
python3 /data/sched/alsched.py submit --cls prod --name tk172-gate --max-runtime 5400 --cores 4 --mem 8 --why "TK-172 кэш опорного: r2 selftest холодный+тёплый" -- bash /data/tk172/run.sh' 2>&1 | tail -5
